import math


def convert_celsius(value):
    """Convert a finite Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit.

    Accepts a finite int or float (but not bool). Anything else,
    including non-finite numbers, raises ValueError.
    """
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("value must be a finite int or float")
    if not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("value must be finite")
    return value * 9 / 5 + 32
